name: Niscolauk
backstory: Lives at Sit:Nalta and keeps a quiet post there because he cares for the place. Tends the garden, and often strolls with whatever visitors pass through.

items: inhabitant: Gurk (cross-locality travelers/routes (named, with a mode of travel))

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only as long as the grounds themselves stay tended, whatever else happens to the place
criterion.wasted_life: one spent letting Sit:Nalta's grounds go to weed and rubble the way everything else there already has
criterion.trusts: what's still growing when he checks on it himself
criterion.distrusts: someone's word that a thing is fine without him having laid eyes on it

routines.routine_actions: walks the grounds every morning checking what needs mending, greets whatever visitors have wandered in overnight, points them toward the ruins worth seeing
makes the trip to Tyrnea now and then for tools and seed he can't grow himself
spends the quiet afternoons on his knees in the beds, patient about it in a way nothing else in his day is

arc.premise: Niscolauk wants to bring the old ornamental garden bed near the Salon Divino back from rubble and weed - the last part of Sit:Nalta's grounds nobody's touched since the ruins went quiet. Resolution: it blooms again by the time the next visitors come through, or the frost gets it first and he's back to just clearing weeds for another year.
